title: Sam CS urges young music directors to focus on melodies
description: In a recent discussion, Sam CS voiced his apprehensions regarding the prevailing music trends, encouraging budding composers to focus on producing high-quality music. He emphasized that modern audiences prefer rich and diverse compositions over transient fads. While he sometimes struggles to connect with the prevailing loud music trends, he commended peers such as Anirudh, GV Prakash, and Santhosh Narayanan for their melodious contributions.
